analysis:
Documentation-only PR: docs/architecture/inference.md (Flint section, head lines ~2071-2114, source list 2185-2203) and docs/developer/test.md (new live-test paragraph at head lines 923-935). No code, config, key handling, wire protocol or deployment changes. Units examined: both inference.md head excerpts, test.md metadata unit and patch.

Security-relevant claims documented rather than implemented here. (1) Flint request policy now accepts reasoning effort/enabled/enable_thinking controls with no prompt effect, and withholds reasoning when exclude/include_reasoning=false/enabled=false. Withheld reasoning still counts in completion_tokens and reasoning_tokens, and FlintReasoningLogprobsFilter drops reasoning-span logprob entries. Accounting remains bound to real tokens, so no billing bypass is visible from the docs. Whether the filter really prevents hidden reasoning leaking via relay logprobs (A-001, T-008 area) depends on the unseen Swift code (NativeToolStreamRouter.swift, FlintReasoningLogprobsFilter.swift). (2) Tools plus response_format get only the response format. This is described as fail-closed (400/422). (3) Relay logprobs are emitted only on the coordinator relay path, which is encrypted hop by hop per the existing model.

The test.md paragraph describes opt-in live tests gated by environment variables, using loopback HTTP and optional receipts. It introduces no production attack surface.

No threat-model entry (T-041, TB-002, TB-007) is contradicted by these doc changes. Remaining integration question: the underlying code PR, which is not in this batch, should be reviewed for the reasoning-withholding and logprobs filtering behavior, since doc claims are not evidence of correctness.
